_doc: COMPONENT 2 - the translation table: rich routine label -> executable gesture. This is the ONLY place where log vocabulary meets UI selectors. Everything else is data-driven from routine.json (values, cells, screens). Inspectable for Q&A; brittle-by-design surface coupling is exactly what novelty items N1-N4 address at higher abstraction levels.

engines.playwright: demo engine (Microsoft, open source) - same role Automagica played for smartRPA (Agostinelli CiI'22)

gesture_types.excel_open: Excel panel boots, file content shown
gesture_types.type: type value into element (real keystrokes); attend=true = smartRPA-style requirement point: robot pauses and highlights, human types, robot continues
gesture_types.excel_copy: select Excel cell B{Row} from the log event's own Row attribute, flash copy chip
gesture_types.paste: transfer clipboard value into element (paste semantics, no keystrokes)

value_sources.Value: the literal value carried by this event in the log
value_sources.Row: the log event's Row attribute (for cell addressing)
value_sources.clipboard: value captured by the previous excel_copy
